Serving Omaha Metro

Keeping your lawn looking its best in Omaha can feel like a constant battle. Between the unpredictable Nebraska weather, the surprisingly fast growth in the spring, and just the general busyness of life, finding time to mow is tough. My name is Bryan, and at A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service, we offer a straightforward, reliable lawn mowing service to take that chore off your hands.

More Than Just a Quick Mow – We Handle the Details

For us, mowing the lawn isn't just about cutting the grass short. It’s about making your yard look genuinely neat and cared for. A lot of companies rush through, leaving clumps of grass behind or missing spots along the fence. We take the time to do it right, ensuring an even cut across your entire property, whether you're in a newer development out in Elkhorn or have an established yard in an older neighborhood like Dundee.

Photo coming soon

We pay attention to the little things that make a big difference. That means sharp blades for a clean cut that keeps your grass healthy, and alternating our mowing patterns to avoid creating ruts in your lawn. After a long, wet spring, the last thing you want is a sloppy-looking yard. We make sure it looks sharp every time.

What Our Mowing Service Always Includes

When you hire us to take care of your lawn, you get the full treatment. We don't cut corners. Here’s what you can expect every single time:

Professional Mowing

We use commercial-grade mowers to provide a consistent, high-quality cut for your entire lawn, no matter the size.

Crisp Edging

We'll create a clean, sharp line along all your sidewalks, driveways, and patios for a truly finished look.

Detailed Trimming

Our crew trims around all obstacles like trees, fences, and flower beds where the mower can't reach.

Complete Cleanup

We blow all grass clippings off of your hard surfaces, leaving your property looking tidy and clean.

Flexible Scheduling for Omaha Homeowners

Life gets busy, and your lawn care shouldn't add to the stress. We offer flexible scheduling options to fit your needs. Whether you need a one-time mow before a backyard party or want to set up a regular weekly or bi-weekly service throughout the season, we can work with you. We service the entire Omaha metro, from Papillion to Bennington, so you can count on us to be there when you need us.

And if you're dealing with more than just an overgrown lawn, remember that we handle all sorts of yard cleanup. From fallen branches after a storm to getting rid of weeds that have taken over, we can bundle services to get your whole yard back in shape. We're also experts in shrub and hedge trimming to keep everything looking neat.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does lawn mowing cost in Omaha?

The price depends on the size of your yard, but our services are typically 40-60% less than the big national chains. We can give you a free, no-obligation estimate so you know the exact cost upfront.

Do I need to be home for you to mow my lawn?

Not at all. As long as we have access to the areas that need to be mowed and any pets are secured, you can go about your day. We’ll handle the work and you can come home to a great-looking lawn.

What happens if it rains on my scheduled mowing day?

We watch the Omaha weather closely. If it rains, we’ll reschedule your service for the next available dry day to ensure we can do a quality job without damaging your lawn.

Do you bag the grass clippings?

We generally recommend mulching the clippings back into the lawn, as it provides valuable nutrients. However, if you prefer for us to bag and haul them away, we can certainly do that as part of our yard waste removal service.
